seoTitle: Net Worth Calculator: Assets Minus Debts
metaDescription: Add up assets and debts from a pasted list to get net worth, debt ratio and your largest items. Free and private.
intro: Total assets, total liabilities and net worth from a list.
why:
Net worth is what you own minus what you owe. Tracking it once or twice a year shows progress better than any single account balance.

Paste one item per line starting with asset or debt. Value assets at what you could sell them for, and debts at the amount still owed.
howTo: Write one line per item: asset or debt, name, value.
Read the totals and net worth.

faq.a: Many people do, at estimated market value, with the mortgage as a debt. Some also show net worth without it.
Nothing you type leaves your browser.
Include them if you want. Note that they may not be accessible yet.
